About.title: The Developer Behind the Code
About.description: I'm a Computer Science graduate from Universiti Teknikal Malaysia Melaka (UTeM), focused on building practical mobile, web, and cloud-connected solutions. During my internship at Bumi Terus ITS, I developed Flutter CCTV streaming features, an IoT monitoring dashboard, and worked with AWS video services. My other projects include an Arabic learning platform, a collaborative tourism planner, and a C++/MySQL rental management system.
